title: Sachin Sachdeva
text:
Hi, I’m Sachin, a PhD candidate in Statistics.
This is my personal academic website built using Quarto + GitHub Pages.


I’m in the final phase of my PhD at the University of Hyderabad.
My work focuses on stochastic modeling, Markov processes, Goodness of fit and statistical estimation.




PhD in Statistics, University of Hyderabad (2020–present)

M.Sc. in Statistics, XYZ University

B.Sc. in Mathematics, ABC College





Stationary & Markovian stochastic processes

Generalized exponential distributions

Bivariate modeling using copulas
